messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 1753214321 — billing pipeline detected invoice_delta > 12% (EU) across recent window. Auto-page to #incidents. Paging oncall.
simon: @amber_oncall can you take this? pattern looks like a counting/emit anomaly, might be duplicate emits.
amber_oncall: on it. pulling quick context — are customers getting overage emails? :eyes:
james_finance: yep, ops-notify-bot just spit out 41 invoice alerts to customers in the last 8m. getting 2-3 PMs already.
ops-notify-bot: notification-log: {"sent":41, "severity":"high", "region":"eu-west"}
maria_eng: starting basic triage. checking emitter lag and redis TTLs now. will paste queries.
maria_eng: running: `SELECT region, count(*) as spikes FROM billing.invoice_emits WHERE ts > now() - interval '15 minutes' GROUP BY region ORDER BY spikes DESC;`
maria_eng: ```
region | spikes
-------+-------
eu-west | 1243
us-east | 32
ap-south | 4
```
simon: ouch. that's concentrated in eu-west which matches finance alerts.
amber_oncall: ok. hypothesis: recent deploy of emitter v2 might be duplicating or failing acks. who owns deploy? @maria_eng any recent rollout to emitter cluster?
maria_eng: i triggered a fast patch at 1753209000 for kv-cache handling on emitter v2. rolling window aligned with spike timeline.
eli_oncall: pinging infra to check network flaps between emitter and aggregator.
amber_oncall: mitigation plan proposal: 1) pause overage emails 2) flip reader to fallback emitter cluster 3) enable dedupe flag in aggregator 4) schedule backfill/replay to fix counts. agree?
james_finance: please pause emails ASAP. I'll hold customer comms until we know extent.
maria_eng: commands:
```
# pause notifications
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/alerts/pause -d '{"service":"invoice-notifier","reason":"emit-delta-spike"}'
# switch route
kubectl annotate svc/emitter-route route=fallback --namespace=billing
``` 
maria_eng: patch applied: notifications paused (resp 200). switching route now.
ops-notify-bot: pause-confirmed: service=invoice-notifier paused_by=maria_eng at=1753214560
maria_eng: route annotation applied; emitter traffic shifted to fallback cluster. starting aggregator dedupe flag toggle.
amber_oncall: aggregator dedupe toggled to ON. monitoring token counts.
maria_eng: quick check after reroute: `SELECT sum(delta) FROM billing.invoice_emits WHERE ts > now() - interval '5 minutes';` -> reduced by ~86% from peak.
simon: good signal. james — can you confirm customer-facing alerts are silenced?
james_finance: confirmed — outgoing overage emails halted. I see hold in delivery queue.
ops-notify-bot: delivery-queue-status: paused=41, queued=0
eli_oncall: taking over for amber for the remainder of oncall window. I'll coordinate post-incident tasks and replay window.
amber_oncall: passing oncall to @eli_oncall. amber status: mitigated, monitoring. handing off.
eli_oncall: acknowledged — I'll keep watch. first next steps: run reconciliation job to compute corrected invoice deltas for affected window, TTL checks on emitter, and draft incident note.
maria_eng: scheduled replay job: `replay-billing --start 2026-03-01T10:10Z --end 2026-03-01T10:40Z --target=backfill-cluster` (job queued)
eli_oncall: assigning postmortem to maria_eng+james_finance. ops action items: (1) confirm root cause of duplicate emits (2) restore notification pipeline with dedupe opt (3) reprocess counts and credit customers if needed.
simon: add severity: S2 customer visible billing alerts. recommend notifying a small advisory to affected customers once we have reconciliation numbers.
james_finance: agreed. i'll draft customer-facing note once replay results are available.
amber_oncall: final note before handoff: telemetry shows KV ack latency spike at 1753208700 correlated with our emitter patch. likely regression in ack path. will include in postmortem.
eli_oncall: last check-in 1753215030 — system stable on fallback cluster, no new overage emails sent. closing page, keeping thread open for postmortem updates.
